proof_text:
have h_swap : SwapSimultaneous X Y h_precond = (Y, X) := by
    simp [SwapSimultaneous]
    <;> rfl

  have h_main : SwapSimultaneous_postcond X Y (SwapSimultaneous X Y h_precond) h_precond := by
    rw [h_swap]
    constructor
    · -- Prove (Y, X).1 = Y
      rfl
    constructor
    · -- Prove (Y, X).2 = X
      rfl
    · -- Prove (X ≠ Y → (Y, X).fst ≠ X ∧ (Y, X).snd ≠ Y)
      intro h_ne
      constructor
      · -- Prove (Y, X).fst ≠ X
        -- (Y, X).fst = Y, so we need Y ≠ X
        intro h_eq
        apply h_ne
        linarith
      · -- Prove (Y, X).snd ≠ Y
        -- (Y, X).snd = X, so we need X ≠ Y
        intro h_eq
        apply h_ne
        linarith

  exact h_main
